findings.requirement: P06-CBT-10 safe reset/action cancellation without cancelling a newly authorized action
findings.title: Old _stop_job cancels a legitimate same-kind replacement when attack IDs repeat in a new encounter epoch
findings.repro: Actual foot-audio callback uses combat.reset(), player.reset(current_position), then use_ability(); no direct cooldown edits. Numeric next_attack_id reset makes old epoch6/id1 and new epoch7/id1 collide.
findings.actual: Callback starts new special/job1 successfully; after old Core cleanup in same tick137 action becomes empty/id0/jobs0. New-shove positive control passed but did not exercise same-kind epoch ID reuse.
findings.fix: Cancel only the old source action with matching encounter epoch, pinned authority/action context and numeric attackID, plus existing lifetime/actor guards. Do not deny normal reset/newF or weaken the test.
acceptance: Unchanged actual epoch replacement qualification preserves new epoch7/id1 special/job1 after old cleanup.
Old job cannot move, damage, reserve another receipt or cancel the replacement action.
Existing no-replacement cancel/reset, new-shove control, authority replacement, free and once semantics remain passing on new frozen source.
